params.body:
The Observatory and the Studio share one session, so a member of gentells.com signed in to the Observatory arrives signed in at `/studio/`. The pipeline refuses a guest every read and write in the Studio, so it drew a desk of refusals. It now says the Studio is where the team writes and links back to the Observatory.

Tests 49/49, build green. Goes with gentells-pipeline and gentells-dashboard `workbench/member-access`.
params.title: A gentells.com member who reaches the Studio is told it is the team's
